convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for the AbsolutelyNoLagLwma custom indicator which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. Requires the custom indicator .ex5 file to function. The EA logic itself is straightforward but depends on an external custom indicator for signal generation.

other_exits: Signal reversal closes opposite position and opens new position in reverse direction

custom_logic_notes: EA uses the AbsolutelyNoNoLagLwma custom indicator via iCustom(). The indicator provides a signal buffer where color/line changes indicate trend direction. Long signal when indicator line turns upward (blue), short signal when it turns downward (red). The EA checks for new bar formation before evaluating signals. When a reversal signal occurs, the existing position is closed and a new position in the opposite direction is opened. SL/TP values in pips are converted to price distance using Point with digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers (multiplying input values by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001).
python_conversion_notes: The AbsolutelyNoNoLagLwma custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It is a zero-lag linear weighted moving average variant. The signal logic is based on the indicator changing direction/color. SL/TP are fixed pip values with 5-digit broker adjustment. The new bar check means signals are evaluated once per completed bar. The reversal logic closes existing positions before opening new ones in the opposite direction.
